name: OpenShellBackend

test_list.description: Register canonical policy bytes under their BLAKE3 CID and reject unknown CIDs.
Reject oversized output and invalid sandbox paths instead of truncating or widening access.
Require mTLS health and exact v0.1.4 gateway version before exposing the backend.
Reject missing, missing-from-store, or hash-mismatched policy CIDs before sandbox creation.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Gateway endpoint, mTLS material, version gate and operation bounds.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Sandbox request with a required policy CID.

output_description: A ready sandbox created with the exact CID-verified policy, or a typed failure.
